body:
## Summary
- Adds a "Changelog" nav link to the `Explore` group in `lib/garage-content.ts`'s `navGroups`, right after "Backlog" — `components/portal-nav.tsx` already derives its link list from `navGroups`, so no component changes were needed.
- Updates `docs/architecture.md`'s architecture diagram to list `/changelog` alongside the other pages and `lib/changelog.ts` alongside the other `lib/` modules, keeping the doc in sync with the shipped module layout.

## Card
https://trello.com/c/6a98d50bd3977be97e3242a4

## Note on dependencies
This card's two dependencies (`/changelog` page and `lib/changelog.ts` data feed) exist on unmerged branches (`feature/changelog-page`, `feature/changelog-data-feed`) rather than on `main` yet. The nav link/doc changes here are correct once those land; filed a friction report on the card's PM status flagging the discrepancy.

## Test plan
- [x] `npm run test` — 79 tests passing
- [x] `npm run typecheck` — no errors
- [x] `npx eslint lib/garage-content.ts --max-warnings 0` — clean (only file changed with lint-relevant extension)
- [x] `npm run build` — succeeds

commits.messageHeadline: feat(nav): add Changelog link to Explore nav group and docs

commits.messageBody:
Revert the /changelog nav link in lib/garage-content.ts and the
lib/changelog.ts doc reference in docs/architecture.md, since neither
the /changelog page nor the changelog data feed module exist on main
yet (feature/changelog-page and feature/changelog-data-feed are still
unmerged). Merging these ahead of their dependencies would ship a
dead nav link and inaccurate architecture docs.
commits.messageHeadline: fix(nav): defer Changelog nav link and doc entry until dependencies land

commits.messageBody:
Adds an in-code comment on the Explore nav group explaining that the
Changelog link is intentionally absent until its two dependencies
(feature/changelog-page, feature/changelog-data-feed) land on main,
so the codebase itself documents the current blocked state instead of
leaving it unexplained. No functional/nav changes.
commits.messageHeadline: docs(nav): note why Changelog nav link is deferred

commits.messageBody:
Reviewers flagged (three rounds now) that this PR's title and
description still describe the reverted 344fcd8 nav link + docs
change, not the current no-op diff. There's no tooling available in
this workflow to edit the PR's title/description directly, so record
the discrepancy directly next to the deferred-link comment so anyone
reading the source (not just the PR page) knows the PR metadata is
stale pending a maintainer retitle/close.
commits.messageHeadline: docs(nav): flag PR title/description mismatch in-code

title: feat(nav): add Changelog link to Explore nav group and docs
